title: CasX GFP-Targeting gRNA IVT
author: Connor Tsuchida
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8uwhwxe
materials: Combine with other pellets of the same sample.
Use UV shadowing to identify RNA bands.
Crush gel pieces with RNase Free serological pipette.
Move samples to 15mL Amicon 3kDa MWCO Concentrators.

steps.title: Prepare 2× Formamide Dye
steps.instruction: Mix 20 mL formamide, 2.2 mL 100 mM EDTA (to give 10 mM final), a spatula tip‑ful of powdered xylenecyanol, and a spatula tip‑ful of powdered bromophenol blue; this solution is the 2× formamide dye.

steps.title: Take pre‑DNase sample
steps.instruction: Combine 10 µL pre‑DNase sample with 10 µL 2× formamide dye for analytical gel.

steps.title: Add RNase‑Free DNase
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL RNase‑Free DNase to each 1 mL reaction.

steps.title: Incubate DNase reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the DNase‑treated samples in an RNase‑free heat block at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Spin down pyrophosphate
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes at 4 °C, 15000 × g for 8 minutes to pellet pyrophosphate.

steps.title: Transfer and add dye
steps.instruction: Transfer 3 mL supernatant to a new tube and add 3 mL 2× formamide dye.

steps.title: Hold on ice
steps.instruction: Keep the tubes on ice; they may be frozen at –80 °C until gel purification.

steps.title: Long centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, 4000 rpm for approximately 1 hour to obtain 1 mL per reaction.

steps.title: Split into aliquots
steps.instruction: Divide each 1 mL reaction into three Eppendorf tubes of 333 µL each.

steps.title: Add NaOAc
steps.instruction: Add 0.3 vol (100 µL) of 3 M NaOAc to each 333 µL aliquot.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet in 200–300 µL DEPC‑treated water.

steps.title: Heat incubation with lid open
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on a 37 °C heat block with the lid open and a kim‑wipe on top; incubate for 30–60 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Pipette off the supernatant.

steps.title: Add chilled ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL chilled 100 % ethanol (3 vol) to each tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge ethanol precipitate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, 20000 × g for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70 % EtOH
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 70 % ethanol to each pellet, then pipette off the supernatant.

steps.title: Final cold spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, 20000 × g for 30 minutes (ensure samples are at 4 °C before spin).

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Label the tubes and store the RNA at –80 °C.

steps.title: Pre‑run PAGE gel
steps.instruction: Run the PAGE gel at 25 W for ~30 minutes or until the metal plate feels warm.

steps.title: Heat‑denature samples
steps.instruction: Heat‑denature the samples at 65 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Load samples into gel
steps.instruction: Load each sample into separate wells of the gel.

steps.title: Wrap gel
steps.instruction: Remove the gel, sandwich it between Saran wrap.

steps.title: Excise bands
steps.instruction: Using a clean razor blade, cut out the desired bands and transfer them to a 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Add DEPC/NaOAc for IVT
steps.instruction: Add 14.5 mL DEPC‑treated water and 500 µL NaOAc to the Falcon tube (provides 5 mL DEPC/NaOAc per 1 mL IVT reaction and a 1/30 NaOAc ratio).

steps.title: Cast large 15 % Urea‑PAGE gel
steps.instruction: Prepare a 250 mL 15 % Urea‑PAGE gel using 250 µL 15 % Urea‑PAGE solution, 833 µL TEMED, and 30 % APS (volume as per standard protocol).

steps.title: Prepare amplification reactions
steps.instruction: For each sgRNA set up eight PCR reactions (add 1.1× volume for pipette error): 8.8 µL Oligo 1 primer (10 µM), 8.8 µL Oligo 2 primer (10 µM), 8.8 µL Oligo 3 primer (10 µM), 4.4 µL dNTPs (10 mM), 2.2 µL Q5 buffer, 143 µL Q5 polymerase, and DEPC to bring the total to the desired reaction volume.  (Alternatively, a 1× Q5 PCR mix can be made with 1 µL each primer (10 µM), 0.5 µL dNTPs (10 mM), 5 µL Q5 buffer, 0.25 µL Q5 polymerase, and 16.25 µL DEPC).

steps.title: Run PCR
steps.instruction: Thermocycle: 30 s at 98 °C (initial denaturation); 35 cycles of 10 s at 98 °C, 20 s at 51 °C, 20 s at 72 °C; final extension 2 min at 72 °C; hold at 4 °C. Reactions may be frozen at –20 °C.

steps.title: Check PCR product size
steps.instruction: Run a portion of each PCR reaction on an agarose gel to verify product size.

steps.title: Split PCR product for IVT
steps.instruction: From each 200 µL PCR reaction (25 µL × 8 tubes), split into three tubes of 66.6 µL; each will become a 1 mL IVT reaction without prior cleanup.

steps.title: Set up IVT reaction
steps.instruction: For each 1 mL IVT reaction add 100 µL 10× IVT buffer, 200 µL 5× NTPs, 100 µL T7 polymerase, 40 µL RNase inhibitor, 66.6 µL DNA template (≈15 µg), and 493.4 µL DEPC‑treated water.

steps.title: Incubate IVT
steps.instruction: Incubate the IVT reactions in an RNase‑free heat block at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Add DNase buffer
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL 10× DNase buffer to each 1 mL IVT reaction.

steps.title: Take post‑DNase sample
steps.instruction: Take 10 µL of the post‑DNase IVT sample and mix with 10 µL 2× formamide dye for analytical gel.

steps.title: Run analytical gel
steps.instruction: Run the analytical gel at 45 W for 3–4 hours.

steps.title: Filter sample
steps.instruction: Filter the sample through a 0.22 µm Corning filter into a 50 mL tube and keep on ice.

steps.title: Wash pellet (first)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 70 % ethanol to the pellet, pipette off supernatant, then centrifuge at 4 °C, 20000 × g for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Wash pellet (second)
steps.instruction: Repeat: add 200 µL 70 % ethanol, pipette off supernatant, centrifuge at 4 °C, 20000 × g for 10 minutes.
